image_description: A close-up view of a bicycle wheel assembly featuring a mechanical disc brake system. The image shows a perforated metal rotor attached to the wheel hub, a black caliper mechanism mounted to the fork, and the lower portion of a black suspension fork with 'SR SUNTOUR' branding. The background consists of blurred green foliage.
